test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Directions: Given below are six sentences A-F, of which A and F are static and B-E have been jumbled. Pick the option that gives the correct order of the jumbled sentences.**

A. Dr. Sadao Hoki’s house was built on a spot on the Japanese coast where he had played as a little boy.

B. His father had said, “Those islands are the stepping stones to the future for Japan.

C. His father had taken him to the islands of those seas and taught him things he had not forgotten.

D. As a boy, Sadao had climbed the pines, supporting himself on his bare feet as the men did in the South Seas.

E. The square stone house was set upon rocks above a beach outlined with bent pines.

F. “Where shall we step from them?” Sadao had asked seriously.
solution: The correct answer is 'AEDCBF'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The sentence 'A' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "**Dr. Sadao Hoki’s house**". Hence, 'A' is the first part. • Sentence E will come after A because it explains **the setup of the doctor's house**. • Sentence D will come after E because it explains what Dr. Sadao used to do in the South Seas when he was a child. • Sentence C will come after D because it explains **what the doctor's father used to do with the doctor**. • Sentence B will come after C because it explains what the doctor's father said about the islands of the South Seas. • The sentence 'F' is the concluding part because it explains what the doctor finally asked his father. Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *Dr. Sadao Hoki’s house was built on a spot on the Japanese coast where he had played as a little boy. The square stone house was set upon rocks above a beach outlined with bent pines. As a boy, Sadao had climbed the pines, supporting himself on his bare feet as the men did in the South Seas. His father had taken him to the islands of those seas and taught him things he had not forgotten. His father had said, “Those islands are the stepping stones to the future for Japan. “Where shall we step from them?” Sadao had asked seriously.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__** __ • Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__: __ • Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options. • Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence). • Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • वाक्य 'A' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "डॉ. सदाओ होकी के घर" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'A' पहला भाग है। • वाक्य E, A के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह डॉक्टर के घर की व्यवस्था की व्याख्या करता है। • वाक्य D, E के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बताता है कि डॉ. सदाओ जब बच्चा था तब दक्षिण समुद्र में क्या किया करता था। • वाक्य C, D के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बताता है कि डॉक्टर के पिता डॉक्टर के साथ क्या करते थे। • वाक्य B, C के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बताता है कि डॉक्टर के पिता ने दक्षिण समुद्र के द्वीपों के बारे में क्या कहा। • वाक्य 'F' अंतिम भाग है क्योंकि यह बताता है कि डॉक्टर ने अपने पिता से आखिर में क्या पूछा। 9b:T102e, The correct answer is 'than you knows'.
